title: 第23章 黑阎王第24章 你做初一我做十五
lines: 震惊过后，陈老将军板着脸，一脸严肃！
“蓝星，这黑阎王老夫在京城都没见过几条，这蛇竟然跑到你床上去了，只怕是有人刻意为之。”
“这样，你把具体情况跟老夫讲讲。”
宁宸思索了一下，道：“就是我准备上床的时候，一掀被子，这黑阎王朝着我扑来，幸亏我反应快...它死了，我活着。”
虽然宁宸说的很轻松，但大家却听得心惊肉跳。
“蓝公子，只怕是有人存心想要害你。”
“蓝公子家在何处？家里几口人，可有什么仇人？你好好想想。”
齐元忠提醒。
这点宁宸比谁都清楚，而且也知道凶手是谁？
他不说，是不想连累陈老将军。
其实就算说了也没用，因为他没证据证明这件事是宁甘和宁茂做的。
宁宸笑了笑，道：“黑阎王京城少见，不代表没有，可能是不小心爬到我床上的。”
“宁公子，你别不当回事...你这次安然无恙，是运气好，因为如今天气寒冷，黑阎王快冬眠了，行动不快...如果天气暖和，后果不堪设想。”
宁宸笑着说道：“可我真的想不出有什么仇人？”
“蓝公子，这可不是开玩笑的，你认真想想，事关你的安危...”
陈老将军摆摆手，示意齐元忠别说了。
“元忠，你去多取一些蛇粉来，让蓝星带回去。”
齐元忠快步离开了。
不一会儿回来了，将一个白色的瓷瓶放在桌上。
陈老将军叮嘱道：“蓝星啊，这是军中将士常备的蛇粉，你回去将药粉撒在床下，蛇虫鼠蚁轻易不敢靠近。”
“谢谢陈老将军！”
陈老将军笑着点点头，“行了，你去训练吧！记住，别训练太久，你还有正事。”
宁宸嗯了一声，带着蛇粉告辞离开了！
宁宸走后，齐元忠忍不住说道：“老将军，这黑阎王在京城的价格不菲，只有那些放鹰逐犬的公子哥可以通过见不得光的渠道弄到。”
“现在这黑阎王竟然出现在蓝公子床上，这分明是有人要害他。”
陈老将军虎眼一瞪，“就你聪明...老夫也知道有人要害这小子。而且蓝星明显自己也知道。”
“可他为什么不说呢？”
“不说，肯定是因为有忌惮...行了，这件事你别管了，老夫自有决断。”
临近中午的时候，宁宸离开了将军府，来到状元楼。
天玄已经在等着他了，还是之前的那个包厢。
宁宸敲敲门。
“进来！”
里面响起天玄浑厚富有磁性的声音。
宁宸推门而入。
包厢里，除了天玄，娘娘腔，大胡子...还有两个年轻人，一男一女。
content_en:
After the shock, General Chen had a straight face and a serious expression!
"Lanxing, I haven't seen many of this Black Hell King in the capital. This snake actually ran into your bed. I'm afraid someone did it deliberately."
"In this case, you can tell me the specific situation."
Ning Chen thought for a while and said: "Just when I was about to go to bed, I lifted the quilt and this Black Hell King rushed towards me. Fortunately, I reacted quickly... It died, but I am alive."
Although Ning Chen said it very easily, everyone was frightened when they heard it.
"Master Lan, I'm afraid someone is deliberately trying to harm you."
"Where is Mr. Lan's home? How many people are there? Do they have any enemies? Think about it carefully."
Qi Yuanzhong reminded.
Ning Chen knows this better than anyone else, and he also knows who the murderer is?
He didn't say it because he didn't want to implicate General Chen.
In fact, it would be useless even if he said it, because he had no evidence to prove that Ning Gan and Ning Mao did it.
Ning Chen smiled and said: "The Black King of Hell is rare in the capital, but that doesn't mean there are none. He may have climbed into my bed by accident."
"Master Ning, don't take it seriously... You are safe and sound this time because you are lucky, because the weather is cold now and Black Hell King is about to hibernate and cannot move quickly... If the weather is warm, the consequences will be disastrous."
Ning Chen smiled and said, "But I really can't think of any enemies?"
"Mr. Lan, this is no joke. If you think about it seriously, it is related to your safety..."
Old General Chen waved his hand, signaling Qi Yuanzhong to stop talking.
"Yuan Zhong, go get some more snake powder and let Lan Xing take it back."
"Yes!"
Qi Yuanzhong left quickly.
He came back after a while and placed a white porcelain bottle on the table.
Old General Chen warned: "Blue Star, this is the snake powder that is always prepared by the army officers. You go back and sprinkle the powder under the bed so that snakes, rats, and ants will not dare to get close."
"Thank you, General Chen!"
Old General Chen smiled and nodded, "Okay, go and train! Remember, don't train for too long, you still have business to do."
Ning Chen hummed, took the snake powder and left!
After Ning Chen left, Qi Yuanzhong couldn't help but said: "Old General, the price of this Black King of Hell is very high in the capital. Only those young masters who let hawks chase dogs can get it through shady channels."
"Now that the Black King of Hell has appeared in Mr. Lan's bed, someone is clearly trying to harm him."
Old General Chen glared, "As smart as you are... I also know that someone wants to harm this kid. And Blue Star obviously knows it himself."
"But why didn't he say it?"
"If you don't tell me, it must be because you are afraid...Okay, don't worry about this matter. I will make my own decision."
...
Near noon, Ning Chen left the General's Mansion and came to the Zhuangyuan Building.
Tianxuan was already waiting for him, in the same box as before.
Ning Chen knocked on the door.
"Come in!"
Tian Xuan's deep and magnetic voice sounded inside.
Ning Chen pushed the door open and entered.
In the box, besides Tianxuan, Sissy, and Bearded... there were two young people, one male and one female.
title_en: Chapter 23 The Black King of Hell Chapter 24 You will be in the first grade and I will be in the fifteenth grade
